title: Lentil Taco Soup
description: Hearty lentils, beans, corn, and tomatoes with mild taco flavor.
substitutions: Use pinto beans instead of black beans.
Add shredded cheese at serving if desired.

steps.text: Combine lentils, beans, tomatoes, corn, broth, chili powder, and cumin in a pot.
Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, and cook 30–35 minutes until lentils are tender.
Taste and add salt if needed. Serve as-is or with cheese.

title: Honey Garlic Carrots
description: Tender carrots glazed with butter, honey, and garlic.
substitutions: Baby carrots can be used whole; cook a bit longer.

steps.text: Put carrots in a skillet with 1/3 cup water and salt. Cover and simmer 8–10 minutes until nearly tender.
Uncover and add butter, honey, and garlic.
Cook 3–5 minutes, stirring, until the liquid becomes a shiny glaze.

title: Skillet Cabbage & Apples
description: Soft savory cabbage with sweet apple and a touch of butter.
substitutions: Skip vinegar if you do not have it.

steps.text: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet. Add onion and cabbage with salt.
Add sliced apple and cook 5–7 minutes more until cabbage is soft and apple is tender. Stir in vinegar if using.

title: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas
description: Crunchy seasoned chickpeas for snacking or topping salads.
substitutions: Use any favorite dry seasoning blend.

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Pat chickpeas very dry.
Toss chickpeas with oil, garlic powder, paprika, and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast 25–30 minutes, shaking the pan once, until crisp. Cool a few minutes before eating.
